articles.title: Iran war dents Middle East sports model as events are canceled or postponed. F1 bucks the trend
articles.description: Two major Formula 1 races are scheduled to be held in Qatar on Nov. 29 and Abu Dhabi on Dec. 6. While the regional conflict has raised safety concerns, officials express readiness to proceed with the events. The reputation of Qatar is under scrutiny following the United States' withdrawal from a sports event hosted there. Saudi Arabia is reassessing its investments in sports due to the ongoing war-related issues.
